# Basement Renovation Costs Vancouver 2026: Complete Pricing Guide

Basement renovations are among the highest-ROI projects in Metro Vancouver real estate. Whether you are converting dead storage into a legal suite, upgrading a rental unit, or simply finishing raw basement space for your family, understanding the real cost in 2026 helps you budget accurately and avoid the surprises that derail projects.

## Cost Ranges by Renovation Scope

| Scope | Low | Mid | High |
|-------|-----|-----|------|
| Basic refresh (paint, flooring, lighting) | $15,000 | $22,000 | $30,000 |
| Mid-range remodel (bathroom, new flooring, drywall) | $30,000 | $55,000 | $80,000 |
| Full legal basement suite conversion | $80,000 | $120,000 | $180,000+ |

Costs are per-square-foot in Canadian dollars and include materials and labour but exclude GST. Final prices depend on basement size, condition, scope of work, and permit requirements.

## What Drives the Cost

**Existing conditions matter most.** A poured-concrete foundation in a Richmond townhouse costs more to waterproof than a Vancouver special character home with a stone-and-mortar basement. If the walls are damp or the floor is cracked, budget an extra $3,000–$12,000 for remediation before any finishes go in.

**Bathroom additions are the biggest single cost driver.** Adding a new bathroom in the basement typically runs $18,000–$40,000 because it requires plumbing, waterproofing, drainage connections, and permit inspections. Relocating any plumbing adds $2,000–$6,000 per fixture.

**Electrical panel upgrades.** Most basement renovations require a new 100-amp sub-panel or a service upgrade. Budget $2,500–$7,500 depending on the existing panel capacity and BC Electrical Code requirements.

**Egress window or door upgrades.** Building code requires a separate entrance and adequate natural light for a legal suite. Adding an egress window runs $3,500–$8,500 per window depending on foundation type.

## Cost Per Square Foot

| Finish Level | $/sq ft |
|------------|---------|
| Basic (paint, laminate, standard fixtures) | $50–$90 |
| Mid-range (LVP, quality fixtures, new drywall) | $90–$150 |
| High-end (heated floors, custom millwork, premium fixtures) | $150–$250+ |

For a typical 700 sq ft basement this means:
- Basic finish: $35,000–$63,000
- Mid-range: $63,000–$105,000
- Legal suite with separate entrance: $105,000–$175,000+

## What Is Included in Each Price Range

**Basic refresh ($15K–$30K):** Floor levelling, new laminate or luxury vinyl plank flooring, painting walls and ceiling, updated lighting fixtures, basic bathroom refresh (new toilet, vanity, shower head), electrical upgrades to code.

**Mid-range remodel ($30K–$80K):** Everything in basic, plus full bathroom renovation with new tiling and waterproofing, custom vanity and countertops, recessed lighting, rewiring for code compliance, potential addition of a second bedroom or den, window replacements.

**Full legal suite ($80K–$180K+):** Everything in mid-range, plus separate entrance construction, legal bedroom egress window, full suite separation from upper floors (fire separation, soundproofing, independent HVAC), suite-ready electrical sub-panel, potential separate laundry.

## Hidden Costs to Budget For

**Asbestos testing and abatement.** Pre-1970 Vancouver homes may contain asbestos in floor tiles, pipe insulation, or popcorn ceiling texture. Testing costs $300–$800; abatement runs $2,000–$15,000 depending on the scope. Always test before demo.

**Soil and drainage conditions.** Richmond and parts of Surrey have high water tables. Waterproofing a below-grade basement in these areas typically adds $4,000–$14,000 to the project cost.

**Municipal permit fees.** City of Vancouver basement suite permit fees range from $2,000–$5,500 depending on scope. Surrey, Burnaby, and Richmond have similar fee structures. Your contractor should include these in the quote.

**HOA or Strata approvals.** If you live in a townhouse or condo with a strata, you need written approval before starting any work that affects common property or building structure.

## Permits and Legal Requirements

Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, and other Metro Vancouver municipalities all require permits for basement renovations that include structural changes, new plumbing, new electrical circuits, or basement suite conversions.

For a legal secondary suite you will typically need:
- Building permit (structural, fire separation, egress)
- Electrical permit (new circuits, panel upgrade)
- Plumbing permit (new or relocated fixtures)
- HVAC permit (if adding heating for a suite)
- Final inspections from all three disciplines

Timeline: expect 4–10 weeks for permit approval on a basement suite application in Vancouver, depending on the complexity and the municipality.

## Return on Investment

Legal basement suites typically generate $1,800–$2,500/month rental income in Metro Vancouver (2026 market). At current resale values, a properly permitted basement suite can add $100,000–$200,000 to your home's assessed value, depending on the neighbourhood and quality of finish.

Even non-rental basement renovations — a home theatre, a gym, a guest suite — recover 60–75% of their cost at resale, according to the Reno Stars project data across 58 completed projects.

## How to Choose a Contractor

Look for:
- Valid BC residential builder registration or licensed renovation contractor
- Minimum $5 million commercial general liability insurance
- Active WorkSafeBC coverage (request the clearance letter)
- Detailed quotes that list every line item, not just a lump sum
- Written warranty terms (1 year minimum, 2–3 years is the quality standard)
- References from at least 3 recent basement projects

Get at least three written quotes. The spread between the highest and lowest is often $30,000–$60,000 on a full basement suite project — that gap usually reflects scope definition, not just overhead.

Reno Stars provides no-obligation estimates for basement renovations across Metro Vancouver. Every quote includes a detailed scope of work, material specifications, and a projected timeline.

To get your estimate, visit [reno-stars.com/en/contact](https://www.reno-stars.com/en/contact/) or call **778-960-7999**.

# 溫哥華地下室裝修費用2026：完整造價指南

地下室裝修是Metro Vancouver房地產市場中回報率最高的項目之一。無論您是想將閒置的儲物空間改建成合法套房、升級出租單位，還是只是想為家人擴展生活空間，了解2026年的真實造價都有助於您準確預算，避免項目中途的超支問題。

## 按工程範圍的費用區間

| 裝修範圍 | 最低 | 中等 | 最高 |
|---------|------|------|------|
| 基本翻新（油漆、地面、照明） | $15,000 | $22,000 | $30,000 |
| 中檔裝修（浴室、新地板、封牆） | $30,000 | $55,000 | $80,000 |
| 完整合法地下室套房改建 | $80,000 | $120,000 | $180,000+ |

以上價格為加元，包含材料和人工，不含GST。最終費用取決於地下室面積、現狀條件、工程範圍和許可證要求。

## 哪些因素影響造價

**現有條件最為關鍵。** Richmond聯排別墅的混凝土基礎防水工程，比Vancouver特殊風格住宅的石砌地下室造價更高。如果牆壁潮濕或地板開裂，在做任何飾面之前，您需要額外預算$3,000至$12,000的修復費用。

**浴室增設是最大的單一成本驅動因素。** 在地下室新增浴室通常需要$18,000至$40,000，因為涉及管道、防水、排水連接和許可證檢查。移動任何管道每個裝置需額外支付$2,000至$6,000。

**配電箱升級。** 大多數地下室裝修需要新的100安培子配電箱或服務升級。根據現有配電箱容量和BC省電氣法規要求，預算為$2,500至$7,500。

**逃生窗或門升級。** 建築規範要求合法套房必須有獨立入口和充足的自然光。安裝逃生窗根據基礎類型不同，造價為$3,500至$8,500/扇。

## 每平方英尺造價

| 裝修檔次 | 每平方英尺加元 |
|---------|-------------|
| 基本檔次（油漆、強化地板、標準五金） | $50–$90 |
| 中檔檔次（LVP地板、優質五金、新封牆） | $90–$150 |
| 高檔檔次（地暖、定製細木工、優質五金） | $150–$250+ |

以典型700平方英尺地下室為例：
- 基本檔次：$35,000–$63,000
- 中檔檔次：$63,000–$105,000
- 獨立入口合法套房：$105,000–$175,000+

## 各檔次包含的內容

**基本翻新（$15K–$30K）：** 地面找平、新 laminate 或豪華乙烯基塑料地板、牆面和天花板塗漆、更新照明燈具、浴室基本翻新（更換馬桶、浴室櫃、花灑）、電氣升級至規範標準。

**中檔裝修（$30K–$80K）：** 包含基本翻新所有項目，加上完整浴室翻新（瓷磚和防水）、定製浴室櫃和檯面、嵌入式照明、重新布線符合規範、可能增設第二間臥室或書房、窗戶更換。

**完整合法套房（$80K–$180K+）：** 包含中檔翻新所有項目，加上獨立入口建造、合法臥室逃生窗、與上層樓房的完整分隔（防火分隔、隔音、獨立暖通）、套房專用配電子配電箱、可能獨立的洗衣房。

## 需要預算的隱藏費用

**石棉測試和處理。** 1970年以前的Vancouver房屋可能在地板瓷磚、管道保溫或吊頂紋理中含有石棉。測試費用為$300至$800；處理費用根據範圍為$2,000至$15,000。在拆除前務必進行測試。

**土壤和排水條件。** Richmond和Surrey部分地區地下水位較高。在這些地區為地下地下室做防水工程通常需要在項目成本基礎上額外增加$4,000至$14,000。

**市政府許可證費用。** Vancouver市地下室套房許可證費用根據工程範圍為$2,000至$5,500。Surrey、Burnaby和Richmond有類似的費用結構。您的承包商應在報價中包含這些費用。

**HOA或Strata批准。** 如果您居住在共有所有權聯排別墅或公寓，開始任何影響公共財產或建築結構的工程之前，您需要獲得書面批准。

## 許可證和法律要求

Vancouver、Burnaby、Surrey、Richmond和其他Metro Vancouver市鎮都要求對包含結構改動、新管道、新電路或地下室套房改建的地下室裝修申請許可證。

對於合法的第二套房，您通常需要：
- 建築許可證（結構、防火分隔、逃生）
- 電氣許可證（新電路、配電箱升級）
- 管道許可證（新設置或移動的衛生設備）
- 暖通許可證（如果為套房添加供暖）
- 三個專業的最終檢查

時間線：根據復雜程度和市政當局，Vancouver地下室套房許可證申請的批准時間預計為4至10週。

## 回報率

合法地下室套房在2026年市場通常產生每月$1,800至$2,500的租金收入。按當前轉售價值計算妥善許可的地下室套房可為您的房產評估價值增加$100,000至$200,000，具體取決於社區和裝修質量。

即使是非出租用途的地下室裝修——家庭影院、健身房、客房——在轉售時也能回收60%至75%的成本，根據Reno Stars在58個已完成項目中的數據。

## 如何選擇承包商

請注意以下幾點：
- 有效的BC省住宅建築商註冊或持照裝修承包商
- 最低$500萬的商業一般責任保險
- 有效的WorkSafeBC保障（請索取清關信）
- 詳細的逐項報價，而非僅有總價
- 書面保修條款（最低1年，2至3年為優質標準）
- 至少3個近期地下室項目的參考資料

請至少獲取三份書面報價。在完整地下室套房項目上，最高和最低報價之間的差距通常為$30,000至$60,000——這個差距通常反映的是工程範圍定義，而非僅僅是間接費用。

## 免費估價

Reno Stars為Metro Vancouver的地下室裝修提供免費、無承諾的估價。每份報價都包含詳細的工程範圍、材料規格和預計時間表。

獲取估價，請訪問 [reno-stars.com/en/contact](https://www.reno-stars.com/en/contact/) 或致電 **778-960-7999**。
